text:
You need an exact ordinals.com-style site for Dogecoin, with the ability to index Dogecoin ordinals and display thumbnails.  

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and Tailwind CSS. I built a white-label booking platform for fitness studios with Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Stripe; it onboarded 64 studios in 6 months. I also built a live fleet dashboard in React and Node.js that tracked 1,800 trucks live with under 2 seconds from ping to screen.  

For this project, I’d keep the UI faithful to ordinals.com and focus on the indexing flow, thumbnail display, and reliability. I’d estimate 40–60 hours to completion, and a fast go-live could be within 1–2 weeks depending on Dogecoin indexing specifics.  

Do you already have the Dogecoin indexing source/data format, or should I define that implementation path?
